method: Three fresh processes per engine, five warm-up batches, >=1s workload loop; OS peak RSS and process CPU include startup, file loading and warm-up. No machine identity recorded. Allocation instrumentation is a separate executable.

rustAllocation.scope: one batch after five warm-ups; inputs and options excluded; results dropped each iteration; requested allocator bytes, not RSS; realloc counts full new request
